events.label: birth
events.text: Oliver Bulleid born in Invercargill, New Zealand.

evidence.quote: ( 19 September 1882 – 25 April 1970 )
He was born in Invercargill , New Zealand

events.text: Mother returned with Bulleid to Llanfyllin, Wales, after father's death.

evidence.quote: On the death of his father in 1889 , his mother returned to Llanfyllin , Wales

events.text: Joined Great Northern Railway at Doncaster as an apprentice.

evidence.quote: In 1901 , after a technical education at Accrington Grammar School , he joined the Great Northern Railway

events.text: Became assistant to the Locomotive Running Superintendent at GNR, after apprenticeship.

evidence.quote: In 1901 , after a technical education at Accrington Grammar School
he became the assistant to the Locomotive Running Superintendent

events.text: Became Doncaster Works manager at GNR, a year after the assistant post.

evidence.quote: In 1901 , after a technical education at Accrington Grammar School
and a year later , the Doncaster Works manager

events.text: Left GNR to work in Paris for Westinghouse as Test Engineer.

evidence.quote: In 1908 , he left to work in Paris with the French division of Westinghouse Electric Corporation

events.text: Married Marjorie Ivatt, youngest daughter of Henry Ivatt.

evidence.quote: Later that year , he married Marjorie Ivatt

events.text: Brief period working for the Board of Trade arranging exhibitions.

evidence.quote: A brief period working for the Board of Trade followed from 1910

events.text: Rejoined GNR as personal assistant to Nigel Gresley, the new CME.

evidence.quote: In December 1912 , he rejoined the GNR as Personal Assistant to Nigel Gresley

events.text: After Grouping, brought back to Doncaster as Gresley's assistant at LNER.

evidence.quote: The Grouping , in 1923 , of Britains financially troubled railways

events.label: trip
events.text: Trip to Belgium with Gresley, Stanier and Hawksworth to see a locomotive.

evidence.quote: to Belgium , in 1934 , to see a metre-gauge bogie locomotive

events.text: Accepted post of Chief Mechanical Engineer of the Southern Railway.

evidence.quote: In 1937 , Bulleid accepted the post of CME of the Southern Railway

events.text: Gained approval to build the Merchant Navy class Pacifics.

evidence.quote: In 1938 , Bulleid gained approval to build the Merchant Navy class of modern 4-6-2 Pacifics

events.text: First Merchant Navy locomotive, 21C1 Channel Packet, built.

evidence.quote: The first Merchant Navy , 21C1 Channel Packet , was built in 1941

events.text: Designed bodies for electric locomotive CC1.

evidence.quote: He designed the bodies for the two electric locomotives CC1 and CC2 in 1941 and 1945

events.text: Q1 Austerity 0-6-0 freight locomotive design appeared.

evidence.quote: His other major steam locomotive design , the Q1 Austerity 0-6-0 freight engine , appeared in 1942

events.text: Patent GB547156 on locomotive steam engine valve gear published.

evidence.quote: GB547156 , published 17 August 1942

events.text: Patent GB547180 on piston slide valves published.

evidence.quote: GB547180 , published 17 August 1942

events.text: West Country and Battle of Britain light Pacifics followed.

evidence.quote: The West Country and Battle of Britain slightly smaller light Pacifics followed in 1945

events.text: Elected president of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers.

evidence.quote: Bulleid was elected president of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers for 1946

events.text: Tenure as CME of the Southern Railway ended at nationalisation.

evidence.quote: between 1937 and the 1948 nationalisation

events.text: Leader, his final steam locomotive design for the SR, appeared.

evidence.quote: His final steam locomotive design for the SR was the unconventional Leader , appearing in 1949

events.text: Delivery of 26 amended shunter locomotives began (range 1949-1952).

evidence.quote: Between 1949 and 1952 , a further 26 of Bulleids amended version of these locomotives were delivered

events.text: Became consulting engineer to CIÉ, Irish state transport authority.

evidence.quote: having been a consulting engineer to CIÉ since 1949

events.label: honour
events.text: Appointed CBE in the New Year Honours.

evidence.quote: He was appointed CBE in the 1949 New Year Honours

events.text: Patent GB616445 on locomotive and like steam boilers published.

evidence.quote: GB616445 , published 21 January 1949

events.text: Appointed Chief Mechanical Engineer of CIÉ.

evidence.quote: In February 1950 , Bulleid was appointed CME of Córas Iompair Éireann

events.text: Delivery of 26 amended shunter locomotives completed.

evidence.quote: Between 1949 and 1952 , a further 26 of Bulleids amended version of these locomotives were delivered

events.text: Retired from engineering work.

evidence.quote: Bulleid retired in 1958 , moving to Belstone in Devon

events.text: Moved to Belstone in Devon after retiring.

evidence.quote: Bulleid retired in 1958 , moving to Belstone in Devon

events.text: Patent GB819493 on railway vehicle brake apparatus published.

evidence.quote: GB819493 , published 2 September 1959

events.label: honour
events.text: Awarded honorary Doctorate of Science by the University of Bath.

evidence.quote: He was awarded an Honorary Doctorate of Science by the University of Bath in 1967

events.text: Moved to Malta shortly after the Bath honour.

evidence.quote: Shortly after , he moved to Malta

events.label: death
events.text: Died in Malta, aged 87.

evidence.quote: ( 19 September 1882 – 25 April 1970 )
where he died in 1970 aged 87
